other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage via Follow-up Time
other_failure_modes.description: Using the 'time' column (follow-up duration until death or censoring) as a predictive feature for the death event. Since follow-up time is structurally dependent on the event occurring (patients who die naturally have shorter follow-up times), this introduces massive target leakage.

summary: The agent implemented a robust machine learning pipeline with multi-seed training, stratified splitting, and extensive domain-informed feature engineering. However, the solution suffers from a critical task formulation and data leakage error: it incorrectly uses the 'time' column (follow-up duration) as a predictive feature for the death event, collapsing a survival analysis problem into a naive binary classification task. Other minor issues include simple unweighted ensembling, relying solely on ROC-AUC, and mild test data peeking during exploratory analysis.
